question: The translocation t (15; 17) (q22; q11) is associated with leukemia:
analysis: The translocation t(15;17)(q22;q11) is specifically associated with acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL), a subtype of acute myeloid leukemia (AML). This translocation results in the fusion of the PML gene on chromosome 15 with the RARA gene on chromosome 17, leading to the formation of the PML-RARA fusion gene, which plays a key role in the pathogenesis of APL.
